**xios-core** is the foundation package for the Xios desktop. It installs the pieces every flavor needs: the Xios display app (Home Screen icon **X11**), the iosc Wayland compositor, the ANGLE GPU stack (OpenGL ES on Metal), the D-Bus message bus, desktop audio, and the distro defaults for fonts, locale, and paths.

You normally do not install this package directly. Pick a flavor instead and it pulls xios-core in automatically:

- **xios-gnome**: real GNOME Shell on Mutter
- **xios-kde**: KDE Plasma Desktop and Plasma Mobile on KWin
- **xios-native**: Linux apps as regular iPadOS windows
- **xios-x11**: the classic X11 server path

The display app is unsigned, so it needs **AppSync Unified** (from the https://cydia.akemi.ai/ repo) to launch.

## 0.1.1  ·  2026-07-29
- Installs the Xios display app (com.max.xios): no more sideloading it by hand
- Every flavor now brings its own display: install one package and open X11 on the Home Screen

## 0.1.0  ·  2026-07-01
- First release: iosc + ANGLE + D-Bus + audio + desktop defaults as one base package
